fato_historico: 1980: Saudia Flight 163, a Lockheed L-1011 TriStar burns after making an emergency landing at Riyadh International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, killing 301 people.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to focus on the preservation of precious moments. Just as we learn to value the steady heartbeat of our resilience, consider how your quick wit serves as a beacon. Perhaps it is a good time to transform past shadows into a brilliant clarity that guides your path toward deep, meaningful connections and heartfelt conversations.
frase_do_dia: Treasure every breath, for your unique spirit lightens the world around you.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the start of new wisdom.
conselho: Nurture your inner spark and listen closely to the wisdom of your intuition.
